say.en: Planning has six limitations. Let us list them as warning signs.
One: plans can create rigidity; managers stick to them even when they should change.
Two: in a dynamic environment, plans may quickly go out of date.
Three: it can reduce creativity, as people only follow orders.
Four and five: it involves huge costs and takes time.
Six: a plan alone does not guarantee success; implementation matters.
So keep plans flexible and review them often.

The plan is ready so late that the opportunity has passed
A plan copied from a rival's success still fails

problem.en: A Ballari garment unit made a rigid five-year plan to export only to Europe. When European demand fell and Middle-East buyers asked for orders, the manager refused because "it is not in the plan". Which limitations of planning are seen?

steps.en: Refusing a good order because of the plan: planning creates rigidity.
European demand changed: planning may not work in a dynamic environment.
The plan did not bring success by itself: planning does not guarantee success.

answer.en: Rigidity, failure in a dynamic environment, and no guarantee of success.
